lore: Slow as the tide. When the basket breaks, crabs spill out.
mechanism: Splitter: a Hungry Ghost with 120 HP and a slow 0.5 m/s plod. When it dies (bullet or shovel) the basket breaks and crab_count Basket Crabs spawn at its feet, spread crab_spread apart, and march on; on a nav route they continue its remaining route. Crabs are flagged wave_split (EnemySpawner keeps the wave open for them) and no_kill_credit (they are extra bodies, not part of the level kill total).
